final_response.answer: For a data‑science focus, the statistics minor should look at STAT 5114 (Statistical Inference, avg GPA 3.87), STAT 5525 (Statistical Learning, avg GPA 3.88), and STAT 5054 (Intro to Statistical Computing, avg GPA 3.89) since they cover core inference, machine‑learning concepts, and practical computing. STAT 4004 (Methods Statistical Computing, avg GPA 3.86) and STAT 5034 (Inference Fundamentals, avg GPA 3.77) also round out the skill set with additional computing and foundational inference work.
